issue_context.title: geomfn: st_segmentize error `makeslice: cap out of range`
issue_context.body:
Reproduce with the following query:

```
SELECT st_segmentize('':::GEOMETRY, 'NaN':::FLOAT8);
```

```

SQLSTATE: XX000
DETAIL: stack trace:
```
